editorialPolicy: Anonymous quotations from official course evaluations. Obvious PDF extraction errors, spelling, capitalization, and punctuation have been lightly normalized without changing substantive wording. Ellipses identify omitted text. These selections are editorial evidence, not a statistical summary of all responses.

quotes.text: I've taken a few digital modeling courses at CU. This was by far the best course. The recorded videos were really easy to follow along with. The projects were really fun and engaging. I think this course should remain structured like this even after COVID. It's really easy to fall behind during in-person lectures. This made it easy to know exactly what you were doing and easy to pause and rewind as many times as needed.
I find his teaching style works well for all types of learning abilities. Really nice and understanding teacher but also works us hard. Would take a class with him again.
This has been an amazing and fun class that I can apply to my studio projects. It was a breath of fresh air because of the interesting assignments and engaged my creativity.

The guided video tutorials were the most effective aspect of this course. Rarely did I ever have to turn to other resources to try and understand the concepts you were teaching. They were always clear and incredibly informative.
Most effective: Everything. Fantastic course, could not have been conducted better. Incredibly educational, rigorous and enjoyable. Least effective: N/A.

Wow, I was blown away by this class. I honestly dreaded it for the longest time, as a portfolio can be a daunting task. Jeremy and Brielle lifted that stress and approached this class so well. Because of them, I 100% know I grew as a designer. ... Jeremy is an incredible instructor. His feedback is not dead. It's active and alive and pushes his students to develop a stronger sense and agency in a design. It's amazing to see a teacher that cares about his students' wellbeing and passions as well.

I love the passion that you exude for graphic design and the care that you clearly have for our success and wellbeing both in school and after. I've learned more in this class about graphic design, typography, and more than I have in the last three or four years at ENVD.

Jeremy has done a fantastic job in clearly explaining projects, their intended purpose, how they will be applicable to us in the professional world, and providing constructive criticism as well as positive reinforcement. He has been incredibly empathetic and receptive in understanding this semester has been challenging for many.

I know this was a weird semester, but I feel like this class never skipped a beat. Every lecture was incredibly useful for each assignment. I really like how each assignment built upon each other, especially the portfolio aspect of the class.

Jeremy is an amazing professor! I have learned so much in this course and finally was able to get a proper portfolio and resume together. He has a great graphic eye and I feel like I have become a better designer learning from him.
Jeremy is the best professor I have had at CU. He is thoughtful and clearly cares a lot about his students. I appreciate how supportive he is of ideas.

I thought you were an outstanding instructor and I feel like I genuinely improved over the course of the class. Miro was also used perfectly, as it allowed us to see each other's work and our own progress. I appreciated when you allowed us to submit assignments that bent the guidelines a bit if it made sense in the specific scenario.

This class is a breath of fresh air. Jeremy inspires the exploration of creativity with all students and drives the excellence of an immersive designing experience. The addition of the AI component really gives the time to get to prototyping and solving problems through strong conceptualization.
This is the best ENVD class I have taken. Jeremy is the most hands-on professor I have ever had and has a great way of offering critiques without being too harsh or not harsh enough.

Jeremy has guided me through the first two years of ENVD and has truly helped me discover my passion for design. He is a great professor. This course has a successful format and it really encourages us to challenge our creativity.

This studio has been one of the most interesting, fun, and rewarding studios I have taken. It has transformed my thought process and shifted my perspective toward thinking about nonhumans in design. Jeremy is an amazing teacher. He is extremely knowledgeable and helpful. We had countless tutorials and examples for projects. I felt supported the whole way through, and I really appreciate that. I feel like I learned greatly, produced meaningful work, and had fun while doing it.

Jeremy has such a unique perspective on the design world, especially using technology in design. He pushed us to adapt to the growing changes in the field of design and gave feedback that challenges traditional ways of thinking. He was also very kind, respectful, and accommodating not only to students but to the other staff as well.
I think this studio was a creative way to think about not just humans in design but consider the animals that we coexist with.
Overall this course was a lot of fun and Jeremy was a lovely instructor. I learned a lot and will be taking many of the skills I learned in these seven weeks as I move forward in ENVD.
Jeremy is an angel of a professor. His kindness, warmth, and empathy not only create a studio environment that students look forward to but also create an environment most suitable for learning.

This class was incredibly informative and helped me develop my own understanding of design ethics and my own principles on which I want to design. ... Overall, I enjoyed this class and found it incredibly valuable for my future and career goals.

What is taught in this class has helped me fundamentally understand why I am in this major at all, let alone the specialty. It should be a required lecture for students in their third semester before declaring a specialty.
This class was amazing. Jeremy is an incredible teacher who really helped us dive deeper into stronger conversations we may have never explored otherwise. I've genuinely loved this class.

I think focusing on our ethics as designers has been one of the more crucial dimensions of design. It's something we barely ever touch on in other studios because we are just trying to go, go, go, so this was a nice change of pace.
Great professor and class. That Jeremy is personable and seems to really care what we have to say means a lot.
This class is challenging and very interesting and I was very pleased with the learning experience. This was by far the best studio class in terms of guidance and learning and work.
There was so much learned in this class going through a whole design process, having a client, thinking about details, and building the project.

I took this course out of a desire to better understand how architects work from initial concept phase up to project completion. This praxis is very well organized and Jeremy holds those in the studio to a high level of quality.

Jeremy is the best professor I've had at CU. With his vast knowledge in computer programs and construction, we were able to get quick feedback and keep the class rolling. He's earnest and fair, whilst managing to be a really challenging teacher altogether. ... He really seemed to enjoy our class and care about each student.
This course was amazing. I learned more in it just in this semester than I have my entire student career.
This class is a community and I'm very grateful. Jeremy is very helpful and a supportive professor.
You were an incredible teacher and were super thoughtful with whatever any of us brought to the table. Overall, I really enjoyed my time in this class.

Transferring into ENVD was really scary because of that learning curve. You made that transitional period really easy while providing really great support. This course was a really great taste of design school and you really put the spark in for the future.

He was always open if I had an idea that was beyond or different than the rubric. The priority of the class was clearly creativity and passion over completing exact rubric deliverables. There was a feeling of aliveness in the work we did.

This has been one of the most fun and creative classes I've ever taken. Not only was the material interesting and allowed for personal interpretation, but the way you taught and interacted with us made me excited to go to class. I felt comfortable talking to you and getting advice, and I usually never talk to my professors. This environment helps ideas blossom and makes me feel heard and accepted. It has also allowed me to connect with my peers better.
I have learned more skills from this class than any other and this has been a great time of growth.
The most effective aspect of this course was the one-on-one check-ins and being there through it all.
I enjoyed having Jeremy as an instructor for this course and believe that he did a great job giving well-rounded design feedback throughout the course.

Excellent instructor. Jeremy is a very respectful and helpful teacher. Everything I ever asked or needed for my capstone project was answered and solved efficiently. One of the best teachers I've had in my college experience.
Jeremy is continuously committed to giving his best to us throughout all parts of the semester.

Jeremy is one of my favorite ENVD professors. He encourages, listens, and understands design in a unique way. After four semesters in ENVD, this course was by far the most applicable ENVD-specific elective I have taken. ... Jeremy tried incredibly hard to stay on top of all the emerging software, which is difficult to do. I can recommend this course to anyone. Best ENVD course!

This class was perfectly timed. This is a real thing that is happening around us, and I feel that it is extremely important that students are educated about how to use it and the ethics behind it. I enjoyed how Jeremy created the class around discussions and collaboration. This created a really engaging class.

This class was one of my favorites I have taken at CU. It was an exciting new set of tools and information enveloped in a diverse set of perspectives and critical thinking around ethics. I think it is so useful for design education moving into a new era of AI. I think this class should be required in this program.

Genuinely one of, if not the best-taught classes I have taken at CU Boulder, coming from a senior who is about to graduate. ... Throughout this class, my perspective on AI has continued to change and I have learned a lot, and I hope this class continues to be taught.

This class was one of the most beneficial and applicable classes I have taken in college. It was fun figuring out how to use AI to suit my needs, and Jeremy enabled my individual curiosities and consistently pushed me to the next steps and to find new use cases. I definitely think that this introduced me to tools that I use in multiple different workflows, and many of the tools I now use daily. This is a class that I view as essential for designers as they leave college and enter the workforce.

I really appreciated such a devoted teacher and clear plans of what was expected of us in each class period. ... I really admire the hard work put into this class from Jeremy because that isn't always the case when the professor expects a lot of work without doing a lot of work themselves to help motivate and push the students.

I have thoroughly enjoyed being in Jeremy's studio this semester. I sometimes feel as though ENVD can prioritize having designers as professors and neglect the teacher aspect of a person, but Jeremy is both. He has been the most well-rounded professor that I have had in a studio. Everything he assigns is thought out and complete. Overall, the class has been constructive and a good opportunity to learn about real-world design scenarios.

I have very much enjoyed being in Jeremy's studio this semester. His teaching style is unlike others that I have experienced in ENVD and has made this a very positive experience overall. He is a designer who cares about our growth and learning, which was very appreciated.
I appreciate how you were honest with all of us during critique and pushed us to keep developing and iterating with unique ideas.
The field trips were fun and insightful. Although the five minutes of focus didn't necessarily help me focus, they continually reminded me of the purpose of my analog center.
He provides great feedback and helpful comments that would help us move forward with our projects. Very responsive and supportive. He provided great field trips that gave us a good perspective.
Overall this has been an amazing class that I'm so happy to have taken.
Overall, I enjoyed the course and had a rich learning experience with all of the field trips and on-site learning.
Overall I really enjoyed the class and feel like it pushed me to be better. Thanks, Jeremy, you rock!
Your teaching is always good and I really appreciate you and the time you devote to us, Jeremy. Thank you for all you do!
